# Commit the work

Load when a request involves any of these terms: commit, stage, files changed, commit evidence.

## Step instructions

Include every path recorded in facts.files_changed in the commit; do not omit any.
You may also include changed paths that are necessary for, or directly related to,
the reviewed WorkNode outcome. For each additional path, include a short reason in
the commit message. Keep unrelated changes out unless the user asks for them.
Stage each included path explicitly, then record the hash and source.
The generic StepEvidence record captures this commit call, and close-out writes
RunsEvidence. reinforce_insights already ran before this
step: if its `cwpilot insight reinforce` calls wrote to the graph document and that
document lives in this repo, add it alongside the evidenced files so its write
lands in this same commit rather than being left uncommitted.

  cd <repo-root> && git add <evidenced files only, never -A/.>
  git commit -m "<message>

  Work ID: <the WorkNode's id>"
  play advance <run_id> --fact commits+='{"hash":"<hash>","source":"<repo-root>"}'

Accumulate multiple commits using += within one call and across calls:
  play advance <run_id> --fact commits+='{"hash":"hash1","source":"/repo1"}'
  play advance <run_id> --fact commits+='{"hash":"hash2","source":"/repo2"}' --fact commits_complete=true

Nothing to commit? --fact commit_skipped_reason="<why>" satisfies the step.
Add --close-out to reach finish in the same call. Never touch git config.

## Facts

- `commits`: List of commits made for this work, each with "hash" and "source" fields. Use += accumulation to build the list across multiple calls or within a single call with multiple entries.
- `commit_skipped_reason`: Why this run has nothing to commit (no code changed, work landed in another repo's run, ...). Satisfies the step in place of commits and is persisted in the generic StepEvidence record.
- `commits_complete`: Signal that no more commit calls are coming for this step.
- `tokens_burned`: This attempt's token usage, if known. Optional and non-gating -- persisted onto the WorkNode as a generic StepEvidence record (independent of RunsEvidence's own tokens_burned, which the engine still fills separately when supplied on the run's own closing call).
